Why: the seat's sub-agent stopped before pushing. The card's landing named the wrong layer. `OrganizationLayout`, `OrganizationsLayout` and `HomeLayout` are top-level routes outside `ConsoleLayout`, and each draws exactly one `<main>`. The nesting every `/apps/*` page (Setup record pages included) carries comes from `@object-ui/layout`'s `AppShell`: it wraps its content `<main>` inside `SidebarInset`, which renders a `<main>` itself (a shadcn no-touch file, AGENTS.md #7). It was measured on the real `ConsoleLayout`: 2 nested mains before, 1 after. The skip link targets the route slot `#console-main-content`, not the `<main>`, so it is unaffected. The card's acceptance (one `main` landmark on every Setup record page; the skip link still works) is unchanged.
